# Frank Goortani

> Personal site of Frank Goortani — CTO at FasterOutcomes, AI engineering leader, author of "The AI-Powered CTO" (2026). Hosts CV, resume variants, and supporting documentation.

Frank is the Chief Technology Officer at FasterOutcomes (AI legal tech, scaling toward Series A). Previously Solution Architect at Uber where he built the award-winning ELLE AI Decision Engine, and Lead Solution Architect at Home Depot Canada. 25+ years of experience across enterprise architecture, production LLM systems, agentic workflows, and scaling engineering teams from 0-to-1 through Series A.

## CV and resume

- [Full CV](https://goortani.com/cv/): Comprehensive career history with role-by-role detail.
- [Short CV](https://goortani.com/short/): One-page overview.
- [Terminal CV](https://goortani.com/terminal/): Interactive terminal-style version of the profile.
- [Master resume](https://goortani.com/resume-master/): Complete experience.
- [CTO resume](https://goortani.com/resume-cto/): Targeted for CTO roles, emphasizes leadership and scaling.
- [Cofounder resume](https://goortani.com/resume-cofounder/): Targeted for cofounder/founder-engineer roles.
- [Contractor resume](https://goortani.com/resume-contractor/): Targeted for independent consulting engagements.
- [Forward Deployed Engineer resume](https://goortani.com/resume-fde/): Targeted for FDE roles.
- [Staff Engineer resume](https://goortani.com/resume-staff/): Targeted for IC track.
